notes: Created comprehensive architectural refactoring implementation plan to address critical concerns identified in post-Phase 3 state review. Plan created with assistance from world-review subagent (prioritization) and planner subagent (structure). Key accomplishments: (1) Analyzed 6 architectural issues from review findings; (2) Structured into 4 phases with specific file modifications, success criteria, risk mitigation, and testing strategies; (3) Prioritized issues: Phase 1 - Memory leaks (Critical), Phase 2 - God Module decoupling & framework coupling (High), Phase 3 - OCP violations & duplicate logic (Medium/High), Phase 4 - Dead code removal (Low); (4) Provided detailed code examples for ImageLibrary dispose methods, state action functions, handler decomposition, LayoutGenerator strategy pattern, ExportManager format registry, CanvasRenderer consolidation; (5) Maintained existing architecture constraints (Vue 3 Options API, ES modules, no build step); (6) Included migration notes and critical file list. Plan ready for implementation by build-code agent with incremental testing.
